verdicts.reason: Both are the same shrunk copy for the skyscraper format: the headline is small and set in a lighter weight than the original, and the cat illustration floats mid-canvas instead of sitting on the bottom edge as it does in the original. That leaves large dead purple bands above and below. A is a little better balanced vertically; B pushes the group higher and leaves an even bigger empty block (about 180px) at the bottom, so it looks top-heavy.
